sanctions.employer_name: chart-emp, kpi:employers, key: part of the decision key (employer + date)
sanctions.employer_number: filter: only 9-digit registrations starting with 5 (corporations) are ranked in chart-emp
sanctions.more_details: skip: per-decision link to the decision PDF on gov.il — one document per employer; not aggregable and it names the employer
sanctions.address: skip: street address of the employer — often a sole trader's home or shop; privacy, and city already carries the geography
sanctions.decision_date: chart-yearly, chart-reasons, insight:trend, key: part of the decision key; detail period start
sanctions.final_sanction_amount: chart-yearly, chart-ind, chart-buckets, chart-emp, chart-sizes, insight:size, kpi:total, kpi:median
sanctions.note: skip: free-text clerk note, 72% empty; its recurring content (turnover-based reduction) is structured in financial_sanction_reduction
sanctions.checked_employees_number: skip: number of employees the inspector sampled (median 4, max 20) — an inspection convention, not a property of the employer or the violation
